verdict: Maybe, with enough capital. Allter pitched certified organic, rash-free diapers on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal from three sharks. Parents pay more for gentle diapers, but big brands dominate and diapers are a high-volume, low-margin product.
angle: Parents worried about rashes and chemicals look for organic and plant-based diapers. Subscriptions and bundles create repeat purchases. Manufacturing needs specialised machinery or a contract manufacturer.
